_meta.purpose: Harvested source-site (grace.com) CSS selectors for every block in the reference report, to inform a block-complete master importer. Selectors verified against LIVE fetched HTML, not assumed.
crossCutting: Grace class attributes carry doubled/trailing whitespace (e.g. 'cmp-card text-on-bkgd   small ') — match by token, never exact string.
Element IDs are per-page random or AEM-path-derived (carousel-6d433d2054, root_container_section_col1_accordion_0) — never key on IDs; use classes.
Most images are AEM Dynamic Media (Scene7): real src in

Card img alt is often the useless literal 'Image of card'/'Image of Media Callout'/'Image of Feature Set' — real label must come from <a aria-label>, .cta text, or the heading; will otherwise fail the Alt-Text Rule.
Several 'blocks' are NOT dedicated source components — they are generic .row/.col-lg-* grids or rich-text; they must be disambiguated by inner content/position, not a block class.
